sources.label: Georgia Secretary of State
sources.evidence_excerpt: The office identified approximately 388 more Election Day check-ins than reported ballots cast in Seminole County. The Nov. 6 update put Greene 262 votes ahead.

sources.label: The Carter Center
sources.evidence_excerpt: The Center observed the full District 154 hand count in Seminole County and reported that it confirmed the county’s certified results.

sources.label: WALB
sources.evidence_excerpt: WALB reported Greene’s win and certification and obtained confirmation Nov. 23 that the state investigation was ongoing, with no announced timetable.

sources.label: The Atlanta Journal-Constitution
sources.evidence_excerpt: Greene trailed James by 58 votes before the omitted results were uploaded.
